name: Processing: smelters and the material ladder
notes: docs/CONTENT.md section 12: five smelter parts (Slag Pot, Smelter Mk1-3, Plasma Forge), the ladder scrap -> steel -> alloy, copper + silicon -> conductor, silicon + crystal -> glass lattice (recipes with station smelter), Forged Steel Plate and Alloy Armour tiles, and the engine wave 1 recipes re-costed with steel (Mk3+), alloy (Mk4+) and glass lattice (Neon Mk2+). Every re-costed recipe is raw-material neutral. Not built: the Refinery (needs ore, CONTENT 10) and the Fuel Cracker (ice is not cargo yet).
